race.comment: SKUA (9) presents second up off a solid return here over 1400m. The leader ran along at a strong pace and he was just chasing the entire way, closing off strongly as the $2.40 favourite to be beaten under a length. Connections have flagged him as a Victoria Derby horse and up to a mile with upside can see him justify that path. DIESEL DESMOND (2) has been right there in two runs back from a spell, boxing on well for second at Geelong second up. Looks another suited up in trip and he draws for a soft run. MISS WAITITI (11) resumes having run a solid race in town on debut in June, she looks one that should relish this trip as well. MILVIAN BRIDGE (8) was solid on debut and is in the mix.
